page.overview:
Who is Duane?

Duane is a major character from What We Found, the third story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. He is one of Hudson's friends who, while childish about it, tries to include him and makes sure he's alright while part of the construction and set up crew at Fazbear's Fright Horror Attraction.

Duane is muscular with black hair long enough to wear in a glossy ponytail. He wears tight black shirts to show off his muscles.

Duane is very playful and immature, retaining his childish innocence and always telling really bad dad jokes. He isn’t afraid of anything, always the first to charge into dangerous situations. While Duane does care for Hudson, his immature nature causes him to be a jerk and speak without thinking.

Duane, along with Barry, offer Hudson a temporary job at Fazbear's Fright before they all plan to join the Navy. However, Hudson's body was so damaged that he couldn't qualify for it. While he and Barry are setting up the new animatronic, he gets mad at Hudson for being scared. The morning after Hudson's death in the oven, Duane and Barry smell something bad in the kitchen and investigate.
